children: Choice Hotels International has named Dominic Dragisich president and chief executive, removing the interim tag he has carried since May.
Choice on Monday said Dragisich has also joined the North Bethesda, Md., lodging franchisor's board.
Dragisich, 44 years old, joined Choice in March 2017, and had been serving as chief growth and strategy officer before taking the helm as interim CEO after Patrick Pacious stepped down in May.
Choice said Dragisich will receive an annual base salary of $1 million as president and CEO, along with an annual bonus with a target of 150% of his base pay.
Pacious has resigned from the board, Choice added.
